from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common()
    line=line[1][0] if len(line)>1 else bg
    hrows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if sum(x==line for x in r)/len(r)>0.8]
    vcols=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if sum(g[i][j]==line for i in range(len(g)))/len(g)>0.8]
    M=[[g[i][j] for j in vcols if g[i][j]!=line] for i in hrows]
    M=[r for r in M if r]
    if len(M)<2 or len(M[0])<2:
        return [[M[0][0]]] if M and M[0] else [[bg]]
    return [[M[i][j] if M[i][j]==M[i+1][j+1] else bg for j in range(len(M[0])-1)] for i in range(len(M)-1)]

def transform(g,dbg=False):
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common()
    bg=c[0][0]; line=c[1][0] if len(c)>1 else bg
    hrows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if sum(x==line for x in r)/len(r)>0.8]
    nh=[i for i in range(len(g)) if i not in hrows]
    vcols=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if all(g[i][j]==line for i in nh)]
    M=[[g[i][j] for j in vcols if g[i][j]!=line] for i in hrows]
    M=[r for r in M if r]
    if dbg: print(bg,line,hrows,vcols,M)
    w=min(len(r) for r in M) if M else 0
    if len(M)<2 or w<2:
        return [[M[0][0]]] if M and M[0] else [[bg]]
    return [[M[i][j] if M[i][j]==M[i+1][j+1] else bg for j in range(w-1)] for i in range(len(M)-1)]

def transform(g):
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common()
    bg=c[0][0]; line=c[1][0] if len(c)>1 else bg
    hrows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if sum(x==line for x in r)/len(r)>0.8]
    nh=[i for i in range(len(g)) if i not in hrows]
    vcols=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if all(g[i][j]==line for i in nh)]
    M=[[g[i][j] for j in vcols if g[i][j]!=line] for i in hrows]
    M=[r for r in M if r]
    w=max(len(r) for r in M) if M else 0
    M=[r+[line]*(w-len(r)) for r in M]
    if len(M)<2 or w<2:
        return [[M[0][0]]] if M and M[0] else [[bg]]
    return [[M[i][j] if M[i][j]==M[i+1][j+1] else bg for j in range(w-1)] for i in range(len(M)-1)]
